criterion_fired: Criterion 4 (Next Steps Specificity) and Criterion 5 (Deal Health Assessment Evidencing)
suggested_change: Criterion 4 should explicitly require: each next step must include WHO (named contact or role), HOW (channel), and BY WHEN (date or relative timeframe). Criterion 5 should require: deal health claims must cite specific call transcript evidence, not inferred engagement (e.g., 'Slack channel confirmed in call [timestamp]' vs. 'technical engagement exists').
